title: ATC Arm Collision — Emergency Stop
description: ATC arm detected unexpected resistance during swing cycle. Emergency stop activated. Magazine position P020 = slot {val}. Clamp pressure P021 = {val2} bar. Cycle time exceeded at T+{val3}s.
probable_cause: Tool not seated correctly in spindle, obstructed magazine pocket, or broken ATC arm.
diagnostic_steps: Do not reset until area is clear and inspected
Check spindle bore for retained chip or damaged tool
Inspect ATC arm for physical damage
Check pneumatic pressure to ATC cylinder
remedy: Clear obstruction. Inspect and repair ATC arm if damaged. Re-run ATC cycle in manual step mode.
required_action: Immediate machine stop. Do not restart without authorised technician inspection.
escalation_path: If TCS-CR-001 is not addressed (immediate machine stop. do not restart without authorised technician inspection.), the fault will escalate in this order: SPN-CR-003, then TCS-MJ-001, then HYD-MJ-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
